lesson.title: Wonder and Resilience
lesson.topic: Exploring how embracing wonder enhances personal resilience and antifragility.
lesson.steelman: How can cultivating a sense of wonder contribute to building more resilient systems in the face of uncertainty?
lesson.example: A historical figure who faced significant challenges but maintained a sense of curiosity and awe, leading them to discover new opportunities and solutions.

rationale: This lesson bridges the gap between abstract concepts like wonder and practical resilience strategies.
